content.short: Mercado Pago is one of Latin America's largest digital wallets and payment platforms, part of MercadoLibre.
content.description: Mercado Pago is the financial services arm of MercadoLibre and one of Latin America's largest digital wallets and payment platforms, serving consumers and merchants across Argentina, Brazil, Mexico, Chile and other markets. For individuals it works as a full financial app with a digital account and wallet, debit and prepaid cards, QR payments, credit, savings and investment products, and crypto trading in some markets. For businesses it provides online checkout, in-person QR and card acceptance, and lending, tightly integrated with the MercadoLibre marketplace. By combining everyday money management with a vast merchant network, Mercado Pago is a cornerstone of financial inclusion in the region.
content.meta: Mercado Pago is a leading LatAm wallet, payments and financial services platform. Discover Mercado Pago and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
